subject.title: Review each selected PR in its own item shard

question: Is the isolated canary and two-item validation evidence sufficient to accept the protocol-v3 item-sharding, mutation-permit, and terminal-reconciliation contract for production review traffic?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes the operational concurrency boundary and durable publication protocol; source-level tests establish intent but cannot establish the live queue and GitHub Actions interaction safely enough for an automated merge decision.

options.title: Require the planned canary evidence
options.body: Keep the PR draft until an isolated two-item run demonstrates the listed cancellation, publication, reconciliation, and telemetry invariants.

options.title: Accept test-only validation
options.body: Merge based on the focused automated coverage and perform the production rollout with elevated monitoring, accepting the remaining operational uncertainty.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Land the item-matrix refactor separately and defer generation-bound mutation permits and terminal reconciliation to a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Require the planned canary evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until an isolated two-item run demonstrates the listed cancellation, publication, reconciliation, and telemetry invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the proposed protocol design and can provide the requested canary evidence and technical context.
